why: PDF page boxes are written as [llx lly urx ury]; a page with a bleed gets the whole page as its bleed box and the page inside the bleed as its trim box. With the /BleedBox and /TrimBox entries and the cross-reference offsets taken out, the bleed .fixed files equal the old ones byte for byte; pages-settings is recorded as a hash of the corpus page with a bleed.
